policy: Readable source differences remain separate. Authority may resolve a general rule without rewriting lower-authority component wording; unresolved conflicts never receive a default.

conflicts.title: Search keep optionality and unchosen destination
conflicts.difference: Card says may keep 1 / discard the rest; rulebook says pick 1, put unchosen cards on respective deck bottoms, and do not reveal them.
conflicts.resolution: Official-primary rulebook controls the general Search procedure; exact card wording remains a source variant.

conflicts.title: Rest Uninfected/non-Infected wording and destination
conflicts.difference: Reviewed face says remove all Uninfected; Medical Support variant says remove non-Infected instead of discarding; ordinary Infection Procedure discards all Contaminations.
conflicts.resolution: Each component variant is retained. Pilot composes the reviewed face as a destination override over the official Procedure.

conflicts.title: Exploration Entrance Noise versus universal Movement Noise
conflicts.difference: Noise is mandatory after every Movement; Entrance Effect is called additional; the worked example resolves one Entrance Noise and then finishes.
conflicts.resolution: No default; BGA Beta replay release 260617-1110 is a licensed-digital strong lead for alternative A, but FAQ v1.2 does not resolve the official wording conflict.

conflicts.title: Duck and Cover multiple replacement targets
conflicts.difference: Card says the other Character but gives no selection/tie-break when more than one other Character is present.
conflicts.resolution: No default; explicit alternatives in review-gates.json.

conflicts.title: Event placement at an undiscovered Nest
conflicts.difference: Events require placement in the Nest; checked sources do not define placement when the Nest Room is absent.
conflicts.resolution: No default; Event impossible-sentence rule is one candidate, not silently adopted.

conflicts.title: Player Help phase sequence versus current rulebook
conflicts.difference: TTS Player Help fronts encode an obsolete phase sequence and 10-card count while the official current rulebook controls base sequence/count.
conflicts.resolution: Retain TTS as source-version evidence; never alias same words to current semantics.

conflicts.title: FACILITY RESTART unreadable exact-source span
conflicts.difference: Prototype exact source ends “Systems must be” with no recoverable following mark; other variants differ materially.
conflicts.resolution: Keep source blocked; no semantic record may invent or borrow the missing mark.

conflicts.title: Supply Room optional keep cardinality
conflicts.difference: Printed “You may keep 2” does not unambiguously state optional exact-two versus any subset up to two.
conflicts.resolution: No default; explicit alternatives in review-gates.json.

conflicts.title: Leaving the Shell source glyphs versus licensed semantic placeholders
conflicts.difference: The component scan preserves three featureless white rectangles with explicit no-match decisions; the licensed record labels all three ACTION-CARD.
conflicts.resolution: No default; retain the literal scan and licensed semantic occurrence independently until current official component evidence resolves identity.

conflicts.title: Reactor Overheating licensed movement sentence omits its verb
conflicts.difference: The official rulebook component occurrence and TTS scan say the three Corridor-orientation Intruders move; the BGA movement entry ends after the orientation list without “move.”
conflicts.resolution: Official/current visible component evidence and the exact scan control; preserve the BGA omission as a lower-authority variant.

conflicts.title: Robot Malfunction effect availability on rulebook pages 22 and 37
conflicts.difference: Page 22 permits effects that only require a broken Robot and ignores repeated Robot Malfunction placement; page 37 says all game effects mentioning the broken Robot are unavailable.
conflicts.resolution: No default; both equal-authority passages and their Rise of the Machine consequence remain explicit.

conflicts.title: Current official Exploration wording versus untitled TTS face wording
conflicts.difference: Official visible faces spell out current Room placement and Moving Cautiously wording; the TTS faces abbreviate placement and print two source-local Secure glyph occurrences in the reminder.
conflicts.resolution: Official-primary visible wording controls the matching current occurrences; exact untitled TTS and licensed structured variants remain independently preserved.

conflicts.title: Exploration multi-slot assignment has no source-named owner or order
conflicts.difference: Each face shows two to four source-local Corridor slots and some show multiple Noise/Door placements, while the rulebook says to place a random Corridor in each shown space and treats components as finite without assigning draws or scarce components among slots.
conflicts.resolution: No default; preserve exact slot sets and all alternatives in review-gates.json without inventing a player choice, spatial order, or extra randomization.

conflicts.title: Military Robot scan punctuation versus licensed occurrence
conflicts.difference: The exact TTS component scan ends the additional-effect instruction with a period after the Robot glyph; the licensed ROBOT_CARDS_DATA occurrence omits that final period.
conflicts.resolution: The source-bound component scan controls over the licensed-digital secondary occurrence; preserve both verbatim without normalizing the BGA record.

conflicts.title: Deadly Claws badge applicability and branch bodies differ by source version
conflicts.difference: TTS scans assign Adult+Drone to the Health panels and Queen to a multi-Wound branch; current official-visible/licensed variants assign Adult+Queen to Health and Drone to a different injured-state branch.
conflicts.resolution: The official-visible current Lose-2 occurrence controls its matched counterpart; otherwise exact TTS and licensed variants remain occurrence-scoped under the authority order and are never flattened by title.

conflicts.title: Infecting Adult/Drone/Queen applicability differs between official and TTS
conflicts.difference: The TTS scan assigns Adult+Queen to Lose 2 and Drone to Contamination/Larva placement; official page 32 and BGA assign Adult+Drone and Queen respectively.
conflicts.resolution: Official page-32 row alignment controls the current visible counterpart. Preserve the exact TTS badge projection and licensed record as separate variants.

conflicts.title: Tail Attack Queen/Drone applicability differs between scan and licensed data
conflicts.difference: The TTS scans assign Adult+Queen to the first panel and Drone to the lethal branch; BGA assigns Adult+Drone to the first panel and Queen to the lethal branch.
conflicts.resolution: The exact source-bound scan controls over licensed-digital secondary data for these occurrences; both variants remain verbatim and source scoped.

conflicts.title: Fury scan omits the licensed attacking-Room scope
conflicts.difference: The scans say all Heavily Injured Characters die and all survivors gain cards with no Room qualifier; BGA says those Characters are in your Room and then affects each other Character there.
conflicts.resolution: No default; preserve literal scan scope, the licensed local-scope lead, and all alternatives in review-gates.json.

conflicts.title: Official Queen Health example versus TTS one-card Repel face wording
conflicts.difference: The official page-35 visible example prints “Discard 1 additional card.” above “Repel the Queen.”; the shared TTS face prints plural “additional cards.” and a preceding Character-draw condition. The official occurrence does not identify either duplicate TTS GUID.
conflicts.resolution: Official-primary wording and two-panel structure control only the exact current visible occurrence. Preserve both TTS physical copies, their shared bytes, punctuation/pluralization, and unresolved copy correspondence independently.

conflicts.title: Queen Health Malfunction/Unreinforce scan versus licensed Malfunction-only row
conflicts.difference: The exact TTS face says “Place a Malfunction in the Queen’s Room. OR Unreinforce Queen’s Corridor.” The discard-3 licensed row says only “Place a <MALFUNCTION> in the Room with the Queen.”
conflicts.resolution: The source-bound component scan controls this exact physical occurrence over licensed-digital secondary data. Preserve the licensed QueenHealthCard12 row as a separate material variant; do not delete the scan branch or rewrite either wording.

conflicts.title: Queen death on last discard versus empty deck
conflicts.difference: Rulebook page 35 repeatedly triggers Queen death when the last Queen Health card is discarded and sequences the drawn-card discard after its bottom effect; both Objective Help occurrences say the Queen is dead when the Queen Health deck is empty, which can happen as soon as the final card is drawn.
conflicts.resolution: No default. SEM-Q-027 preserves draw-empty, additional-discard, bottom-effect, drawn-discard, death, and reset alternatives without changing either official occurrence.

conflicts.title: TTS conditional faces versus licensed schema and ordinal/copy boundary
conflicts.difference: Every TTS face includes “If the card was drawn by a Character” while QUEEN_CARDS_DATA stores only discard/effect fields. BGA keys 1–12 form twelve independent licensed rows, but their suffixes are not printed numbers or source-backed TTS deck order; duplicate Repel/Activate rows cannot be paired one-to-one with duplicate TTS GUIDs by ordinal.
conflicts.resolution: Retain all twelve TTS physical occurrences, ten asset tuples, and twelve BGA rows independently. Candidate sets use exact structured tuples and multiplicity only; they never become title, filename, ordinal, or arbitrary duplicate-copy identity joins.

conflicts.title: Official EYES “Shoot results” versus TTS “Shoot values” and licensed lowercase result
conflicts.difference: Two official visible EYES occurrences say “+1 to all your Shoot results.”; the selected TTS sheet face says “Shoot values”; the licensed row says lowercase “shoot results.” No official occurrence identifies a TTS GUID copy.
conflicts.resolution: Official wording controls only each exact publisher occurrence. Preserve all three TTS physical copies and the licensed row independently; do not create a title-only copy crosswalk.

conflicts.title: Official partial ARM wording versus TTS and licensed variants
conflicts.difference: The official page-3 exposed fragment uses “immediately” and plural “Items”; TTS uses “instantly” and singular “the Item”; licensed uses “immediately” and lowercase plural “items.” The official face is partly overlapped.
conflicts.resolution: The official visible fragment controls only that partial occurrence; no missing text is reconstructed and no TTS physical copy is selected by title.

conflicts.title: Direct LEG/KNEE root selectors versus unselected sheet cells and licensed rows
conflicts.difference: The root deck selects three direct KNEE and three direct LEG faces. Same-title sheet cells 6 and 4 print materially different scope/timing but have no root DeckID/GUID selector; licensed rows differ again.
conflicts.resolution: Only full raw CardID/GUID/CustomDeck/URL tuples define the six physical copies. Keep both selector-gap cells and all licensed rows independent; title, body, source cell, and CardID modulo never pair them.

conflicts.title: BODY Hand Size versus licensed Cleanup-only refill wording
conflicts.difference: TTS says “Your Hand Size is 1 lower.” while licensed BODY says to draw to 4 instead of 5 during Drawing Action Cards. The rulebook does not define Hand Size.
conflicts.resolution: The exact TTS text remains authoritative for its source-bound physical occurrences and licensed wording remains independent; semantic scope is unresolved under SEM-Q-035.

conflicts.title: Direct KNEE local glyph versus sheet Secure and licensed cautious wording
conflicts.difference: The three direct physical KNEE copies contain an unmatched two-lobe glyph. The unselected sheet cell uses the recognized Secure glyph and first-Action timing; licensed text names a malformed Make a Move Cautiously phrase.
conflicts.resolution: No default; retain the direct local glyph, selector-gap sheet face, and licensed row independently.

conflicts.title: LUNGS local terminal glyph versus licensed HP placeholder
conflicts.difference: The TTS LUNGS face uses a standalone stepped-zigzag glyph that did not exactly match page-40 Character Health; licensed LUNGS uses <HP>.
conflicts.resolution: No default; preserve literal morphology and licensed placeholder independently until exact source-scoped evidence establishes identity.

conflicts.title: Thirty-card Green color deck versus regular/Heavy physical-class boundary
conflicts.difference: Official inventory, the TTS root, and licensed multiplicities all preserve 30 Green-type cards. Exact TTS and licensed evidence independently partition 23 regular and 7 Heavy copies, while the downstream ITM-003/004 interpretation says color decks contain only regular Items.
conflicts.resolution: Keep the 30-card root and 23/7 physical-class evidence intact. This bounded batch dispatches only the 23 regular/Backpack faces and leaves the seven Heavy occurrences explicit; do not silently rewrite either source evidence or the downstream interpretation.

conflicts.title: Selected Green local glyphs versus licensed ACTION-CARD/noIntruders fields
conflicts.difference: Selected Adrenaline/Stimulants faces retain blank draw rectangles and a crossed-device upper glyph with explicit no-match evidence; licensed rows name ACTION-CARD draws and mark Stimulants noIntruders.
conflicts.resolution: No default. Licensed fields remain lower-authority variants and do not assign the literal TTS glyphs by expected effect, position, color, or resemblance.

conflicts.title: Contamination Codes root face versus independent licensed Termination Codes row
conflicts.difference: The exact selected TTS occurrence is titled CONTAMINATION CODES and says to place a closed Door in each adjacent Corridor; licensed TerminationCodes has another title and expressly includes destroyed/no-slot placements. No physical identity crosswalk is asserted.
conflicts.resolution: The exact source-bound face controls only its root CardID/GUID occurrence over the lower licensed table. Preserve the licensed row independently; do not join by one-copy multiplicity or functional resemblance.

conflicts.title: Regular MEDKIT, Heavy MEDKIT, and licensed Medkit/Medpack boundaries
conflicts.difference: Four regular TTS MEDKIT copies grant free immediate restore-or-Medpack use; four horizontal Heavy TTS MEDKIT copies print a different Wound/Health effect; licensed Medpack and Heavy Medkit rows are independent.
conflicts.resolution: Only exact physical selectors define regular versus Heavy copies. Preserve all same-title/body/class variants; title, case, effect, multiplicity, or licensed key creates no identity join.

conflicts.title: Green parent-sheet selector gaps versus selected direct/generated faces
conflicts.difference: Cells 2, 4, 6, and 8 visibly preserve Caffeine Pills, Emergency Life Support Codes, MEDKIT, and Synthetic Food variants but have no root full CardID/GUID selector; selected direct/sheet faces differ in text and glyphs.
conflicts.resolution: Retain all four source variants and selector gaps. Never substitute them into the physical deck from title, body, cell position, CardID modulo, or expected game logic.

conflicts.title: Thirty-card Red root versus regular/Heavy/Military Taser physical-class boundary
conflicts.difference: The exact root has 21 source-clear regular, three HEAVY Remote Detonator, and six portrait SPECIAL WEAPON Military Taser selectors. Licensed data has 21 regular/9 Heavy and official page 29 shows a materially different Heavy Military Taser, while downstream ITM-003/004 says color decks contain only regular Items.
conflicts.resolution: No default for the six TTS selectors. Keep every root copy/class/source occurrence intact; only 21 source-clear regular faces dispatch in this batch.

conflicts.title: Selected Red crossed glyphs versus licensed noIntruders fields
conflicts.difference: Anti-Aircraft Codes, Personal Log Codes, and Portable Barrier selected faces retain source-local upper-right all-glossary no-matches; licensed rows mark noIntruders. A separate Exploring Drone occurrence independently matches Not In Combat.
conflicts.resolution: No default and no position/color-wide alias. Licensed fields remain independent lower-authority variants.

conflicts.title: Red and cross-family parent-sheet gaps versus exact root selectors
conflicts.difference: Four Red-sheet cells and three Yellow-sheet cells have no Red-root full CardID/GUID selector. Several share titles/body concepts with selected direct faces; one cross-family cell is non-rules.
conflicts.resolution: Retain all sheet/hash/grid/cell/gap tuples. Never repair a selector by title, color, art, body, cell, folder, CardID modulo, or expected logic.

conflicts.title: Portable Barrier scan versus licensed override and Portable Barricade FAQ
conflicts.difference: TTS says only “Place a closed Door.” Licensed PortableBarrier adds accessible/destroyed/no-slot scope; FAQ names Portable Barricade and says an opened placed Door is gone. Exact applicability/identity and target owner are not stated.
conflicts.resolution: No default; preserve ordinary official Door/local rules and both lower/current-source leads without merging them into the exact scan.

conflicts.title: Personal Log Codes local unspecified target versus licensed Facility scope
conflicts.difference: TTS says Check all Objective cards of a chosen Character without naming chooser, inspector, audience, or range. Official local-effect rules imply local scope; licensed data says your choice in the Facility.
conflicts.resolution: No default for choice/inspection/secrecy or cross-source correspondence; unauthorized Objective exposure remains prohibited.

conflicts.title: Exploring Drone direct root face versus selector-gap and licensed wording
conflicts.difference: Two exact direct root selectors say Exploration Sequence for a neighboring Room without Moving and suppress Entrance effect. Unselected sheet cell 3 says Exploration Procedure through an empty Open Corridor; licensed wording is another independent variant.
conflicts.resolution: Only full direct selectors dispatch. Same title, nearby cell, and licensed multiplicity create no effect identity; target ownership remains SEM-Q-048.

conflicts.title: Ammo Magazine and Grenade direct faces versus sheet/licensed variants
conflicts.difference: Direct Ammo Magazine gains 1 Ammo while unselected cell 0 gains up to 2 and licensed Ammo uses another title; direct Grenade has verified grenadeToken glyphs while unselected cell 5 retains three local no-matches.
conflicts.resolution: Exact direct root selectors control only their physical occurrences. Preserve sheet and licensed variants independently; no title/body/art/token expectation supplies identity.

conflicts.title: Thirty-card Yellow root versus regular/Heavy-candidate physical-class boundary
conflicts.difference: The exact root has 24 source-clear regular faces, five portrait ONE USE ONLY. SPECIAL WEAPON Fire Extinguisher selectors, and one portrait no-HEAVY Robot Controller selector. Licensed data has 24 regular/6 Heavy while downstream ITM-003/004 says color decks contain only regular Items.
conflicts.resolution: No default for the six TTS selectors. Keep every root copy/class/source occurrence intact; only 24 source-clear regular faces dispatch in this batch.

conflicts.title: Selected Yellow crossed glyphs versus licensed noIntruders fields
conflicts.difference: Duct Tape, direct Phosphates, and Tools retain source-local upper-right all-glossary no-matches; licensed rows mark all three noIntruders. Current official Duct Tape shows a corner restriction occurrence but identifies no TTS GUID or exact selected morphology.
conflicts.resolution: No default and no position/Yellow-color/utility-art alias. Licensed and official occurrences remain independent leads.

conflicts.title: Yellow parent sheets, unique-back cells, cross-family cells, and exact root selectors
conflicts.difference: Two 2x2 face sheets retain five Yellow-root selector gaps, including a Red-root Military Taser cell and one non-rules cell. CustomDeck 33 uses cell-matched UniqueBack art shared with the Red root; CustomDeck 34/direct cards use one shared Yellow back.
conflicts.resolution: Retain every sheet/hash/grid/cell/UniqueBack/gap tuple. Never repair or invert a selector/back from title, color, art, body, folder, CardID modulo, or expected logic.

conflicts.title: Duct Tape TTS self-placement versus current official/FAQ One Use stacking
conflicts.difference: Five exact TTS copies say to place this Item and another Heavy Item under a Heavy Item. Current official Duct Tape says place one Heavy Item above another, generic One Use says discard Duct Tape when Used, and FAQ permits a third Item in one Hand. No official occurrence identifies a TTS GUID.
conflicts.resolution: No default; preserve exact occurrences and all three SEM-Q-053 alternatives without title-only correspondence.

conflicts.title: Duct Tape stack later lifecycle and Trade are source-unspecified
conflicts.difference: FAQ confirms a third Item may occupy one Hand, but checked sources do not state whether further Items may be added or how discard, loss, Malfunction, token loss, Trade, ownership, and separation affect a stack.
conflicts.resolution: No default; ordinary Item/Trade transitions do not silently detach, transfer as a group, preserve, or collapse stacked physical copies.

conflicts.title: Direct Phosphates versus selector-gap and licensed target/body variants
conflicts.difference: Five direct root copies say Reinforce 1 empty Corridor OR discard Fire without an adjacency/chooser qualifier. Unselected sheet cell 2 replaces Fire with place 2 Secure; licensed Phosphates adds adjacent to the Reinforce branch.
conflicts.resolution: No default for target owner/range. Exact direct selectors alone dispatch; sheet/licensed wording remains independent.

conflicts.title: Tools scan Door scope versus licensed accessible-Door qualifier
conflicts.difference: Six exact Tools copies say Open or Close 1 Door without naming chooser, target range, or accessibility. Licensed Tools adds accessible; ordinary Door/local rules supply constraints but no exact target owner or same-source qualifier.
conflicts.resolution: No default; preserve ordinary constraints and all SEM-Q-056 alternatives without importing Robot or Portable Barrier effects.

conflicts.title: Oxygen Tank, Robot Controller, and Fire Extinguisher direct/sheet/licensed representation boundaries
conflicts.difference: Direct Oxygen Tank is selected by eight root GUIDs while a same-title sheet cell is unselected and has independent Not In Combat/normalized-placeholder evidence. Direct Robot Controller is a root class conflict while a materially different sheet cell is unselected. Fire Extinguisher is selected only at sheet cell 1 and licensed as Heavy.
conflicts.resolution: Keep all direct/generated/corpus/selected/licensed occurrences and representation discrepancies explicit. Same title, body similarity, Yellow art, cell, or multiplicity creates no identity or effect crosswalk.

conflicts.title: Seven TTS roots versus six final Character Action decks
conflicts.difference: Five Contractor kit cards and five Shared Contractor cards occupy two TTS roots, while the official base rules require one shuffled ten-card Contractor deck and ignore the printed distinction.
conflicts.resolution: Compose exact membership only for Contractor setup; preserve both root segments and every physical selector.

conflicts.title: Action sheet selected cells, base selector gaps, and expansion cells
conflicts.difference: CustomDeck 5674 has 16 selected base physical cells plus 29 base-Character selector gaps; CustomDeck 5675 selects base cells 10–14 while forty other cells are expansion Characters.
conflicts.resolution: Retain sheet/hash/grid/cell evidence; gaps and expansion cells never become base physical copies.

conflicts.title: Selected Action crossed upper-right glyphs versus licensed noIntruders
conflicts.difference: Eight selected generated occurrences retain unresolved/no-match crossed morphologies while licensed rows expose booleans; aggregate true counts and exact occurrence representations are not a source identity crosswalk.
conflicts.resolution: No Not In Combat default; retain exact literal art and independent licensed flags.

conflicts.title: Selected Search octagons versus current official Item Icons
conflicts.difference: Five selected TTS Search faces show local solid octagons with no exact approved glossary match; the current official Search occurrence and licensed rows say Item Icon(s) and corresponding type.
conflicts.resolution: Official procedure remains independent; no title/body-based mapping to TTS local glyphs.

conflicts.title: Selected pixel evidence versus stale Action corpus projections
conflicts.difference: Twenty-six selected physical faces have one or more title/body/footer/upper-right representation differences from earlier corpus printedData, including Combat Drugs Medpack and several Lander/Reaction reads.
conflicts.resolution: Selected source-bound pixel evidence controls the semantic projection; both representations remain recorded without rewriting extraction history.

conflicts.title: Sixty physical TTS copies versus sixty licensed Action rows
conflicts.difference: Counts partition 10×6 in both sources, but no licensed key identifies a TTS deck GUID/full CardID/GUID/cell copy and wording/layout fields differ.
conflicts.resolution: Retain sixty plus sixty independent occurrences with zero asserted physical identity links.

conflicts.title: Sprint TTS/corpus/current-official wording and resource representation
conflicts.difference: Selected TTS says lose 1 Oxygen, an earlier corpus projection emitted Oxygen token, and current official/licensed wording says spend 1 Oxygen; no official visual occurrence identifies the TTS GUID.
conflicts.resolution: Encode exact selected TTS occurrence and preserve current official/licensed occurrences independently.

conflicts.title: Stay Calm local draw glyph versus licensed Action-card placeholder
conflicts.difference: Selected source evidence leaves the upright card/tile glyph unresolved while licensed Stay Calm says each Character draws one Action card.
conflicts.resolution: No draw target default; unaffected Lander/Room/Reaction clauses remain encoded.

conflicts.title: Weak Spots TTS plural versus current official/licensed Weak Spot
conflicts.difference: The selected TTS face is WEAK SPOTS and says chosen Intruder in your Room; current official visible/licensed occurrences are Weak spot/Weak Spot with their own punctuation/wording.
conflicts.resolution: Current official controls only its exact publisher occurrence; no title normalization or GUID substitution.

conflicts.title: Printed Command headings versus licensed command flags
conflicts.difference: Eight TTS physical main panels visibly carry COMMAND headings, while seven licensed rows set command=true because Officer's Channel references playing another Command rather than being flagged as one.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve panel headings and licensed booleans as different source fields; never flatten one into the other.

conflicts.title: Official 7/15/8 inventory versus TTS 11/20/8 competitive roots
conflicts.difference: Official base inventory is 7 Mission Objectives, 15 Private Objectives, and 8 Mission Tasks. TTS roots contain 11, 20, and 8 children; exact GMNotes/Lua filtering leaves 7 + 15 + 8 and excludes four high-count Mission plus five Corporate prototype Private children.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve all 39 root children and exact exclusions. Never lower the official inventory, promote high-count prototypes, or identify copies by title/order.

conflicts.title: Shared Objective sheet contains multiple categories and unselected/prototype variants
conflicts.difference: The 7×3 sheet contains Mission and Personal faces; only exact full selectors choose twelve base cells, while nine cells are base selector gaps and one gap is selected only by a high-count prototype root child.
conflicts.resolution: Keep sheet/hash/grid/cell and each exact selector. Category/footer/title/cell/modulo never supplies membership or identity.

conflicts.title: PERSONAL OBJECTIVE versus Private Objective is exact-source scoped
conflicts.difference: Selected TTS source tuples print PERSONAL OBJECTIVE while the current official category is Private Objective; Corporate prototypes print another footer and the Lua role name is technical/misspelled.
conflicts.resolution: Apply AL-003 only to its exact listed tuples. No global Personal/Private, role-name, footer, or category alias is created.

conflicts.title: Current and TTS Mission Task wording/panel variants
conflicts.difference: Eradication, Primary Samples, Perimeter Clearing, and other TTS faces differ in killed/dead, cannot/NOT, cargo cohort, Room wording, thresholds, and checkbox/panel detail from current visible Help occurrences.
conflicts.resolution: Official visible wording controls only exact publisher occurrences; every TTS physical occurrence remains verbatim. No title/body counterpart join is asserted.

conflicts.title: TTS FACILITY RESTART exact source blocker versus complete current/licensed variants
conflicts.difference: The exact TTS physical face visibly ends one condition at ‘Systems must be’ with no recoverable following mark. Current official and licensed Facility Restart records are materially different complete occurrences.
conflicts.resolution: Retain the one card backlog unit source-blocked. Neither current official nor BGA wording fills the physical TTS face.

conflicts.title: Private Objective current/TTS/licensed text and title variants
conflicts.difference: TTS and current/licensed occurrences differ for Favourites/Crew’s Favorite/We’ve Got History, Veni, Great Hunt, Quarantine, Shutdown, Experimental Subjects, Insider/State’s Evidence, Luxurious Offer, and numbered targets; duplicate wording/titles also occur under distinct keys/copies.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve all exact occurrences and authority. Matching title/body/function never identifies a physical copy or authorizes text replacement.

conflicts.title: Player-count metadata conflicts across TTS and current visible occurrences
conflicts.difference: Exact TTS metadata/visible variants include Perimeter Clearing 1+, An Old Feud 3+, and Hostile Takeover 4+, while current Help shows 2+, 2+, and 3+. Licensed rows omit player-count metadata.
conflicts.resolution: Keep applicability source-scoped. No title correspondence, licensed omission, or GMNotes technical value silently overwrites another occurrence.

conflicts.title: Ten official Help card occurrences are physically occluded
conflicts.difference: Four Official Order copies and six Private Objective occurrences have physically occluded title/count/body/icon/footer spans. Searchable PDF text-layer metadata exists for some but is not visible face evidence.
conflicts.resolution: Index each occurrence and visible fragment independently. Do not create effect records from hidden metadata or fill them with TTS/BGA rows.

conflicts.title: Ulterior Motive ‘remain UNFULFILLED’ timing
conflicts.difference: Ulterior Motive says the Mission Task must remain UNFULFILLED, while the general definition evaluates fulfillment when conditions are met at the end of the game.
conflicts.resolution: No default; SEM-Q-076 retains continuous, endgame-snapshot, and later-window readings.

conflicts.title: Objective OR-branch choice and late endgame choice/reveal ordering
conflicts.difference: Cards and the Help note bar owner-specific branches but do not state branch commitment timing; endgame allows a late Objective choice before reveals without specifying full track/reward handling, chooser order, or reveal/check order.
conflicts.resolution: No default; SEM-Q-075, SEM-Q-077, and SEM-Q-078 preserve the separate choices/order questions.

conflicts.title: Licensed competitive/Solo-Coop rows and TTS Solo/Coop roots remain outside standard copy identity
conflicts.difference: BGA stores 26 competitive and 12 Solo/Coop rows. TTS separately stores 12 official-style and 26 custom Solo/Coop selectors; official inventory says 12 Solo/Coop cards and standard rules do not use them.
conflicts.resolution: Retain all counts without forcing equality or a copy crosswalk. Solo/Coop and custom roots are indexed exclusions from base-competitive conclusions.

conflicts.title: Current official Automatic Shotgun versus TTS Automatic/BF Gun variants
conflicts.difference: Official page 3 assigns current Automatic Shotgun to Heavy Gun Operator with Heavy/Before/if-able wording; TTS misnests an obsolete Rifle/On Hit variant under Combat Engineer and carries obsolete BF Gun under HGO; licensed rows follow the obsolete owner split.
conflicts.resolution: Official current occurrence controls. Exclude both audited TTS prototypes from current dispatch while retaining exact source faces/backs/kit ancestry.

conflicts.title: Seven Character Item count versus incomplete current identity/owner crosswalk
conflicts.difference: Official inventory/setup gives seven and Contractor two, but only two current Character Item owner/face occurrences are fully visible; TTS and licensed seven-row rosters contain known obsolete conflicts.
conflicts.resolution: No default; preserve each source roster/occurrence independently.

conflicts.title: Exact 24-card Support root versus 24 independent licensed rows
conflicts.difference: Counts reconcile at 24, but direct/sheet TTS titles/text/classes/slots and licensed rows differ and no copy selector crosses sources.
conflicts.resolution: Aggregate equality is not a one-to-one crosswalk; retain all physical and licensed occurrences.

conflicts.title: Support 6x3 parent-sheet selected cells versus sixteen selector gaps
conflicts.difference: Only exact full CardIDs 2910 and 2917 select cells 10 and 17; sixteen readable cells have no root full CardID/GUID selector and several share titles with direct faces.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve all sheet/hash/grid/cell tuples; no title/body/cell/modulo repair.

conflicts.title: Printed Tactical Gear slot evidence versus GMNotes/licensed slots
conflicts.difference: Some tracked TTS faces lack source-scoped authoritative slot matches while GMNotes and licensed rows supply plausible counts/types; exact official Heavy Armor/Grenade Launcher slots are separately visible.
conflicts.resolution: No color/title/art/orientation/GMNotes/BGA default; retain literal/corroborating evidence.

conflicts.title: Color-root Heavy occurrences versus stale all-regular downstream interpretation
conflicts.difference: Exact Green root has seven Heavy and Red root three explicit Heavy faces, contradicting the old project statement that color roots contain only regular Backpack Items.
conflicts.resolution: Correct the project interpretation; exact physical occurrences/class rules control, while color remains a source family rather than class.

conflicts.title: Red/Yellow Heavy candidates remain physical-class/source conflicts
conflicts.difference: Six portrait Red Military Taser and six portrait Yellow Fire Extinguisher/Robot Controller selectors conflict with current/licensed Heavy class occurrences without exact copy links.
conflicts.resolution: Keep all twelve out of Heavy/Equipment effect dispatch under SEM-Q-047/052.

conflicts.title: Weapon die-result additional versus replacement scope
conflicts.difference: Earlier component/secondary readings could treat a Weapon-specific result as replacing the standard die result.
conflicts.resolution: FQ-P02-U21 controls only this proposition: effects are additional unless the exact instruction specifically says instead; standard Ammo loss still occurs. Wider timing/targets remain SEM-Q-088.

conflicts.title: Grenade Launcher malfunction exception versus general malfunction prohibition
conflicts.difference: General rules/FAQ block Weapon use and Ammo spending while malfunctioned; FQ-P03-U03 allows attached Grenade tokens through Use Any Tactical Gear.
conflicts.resolution: Apply the exact token-use carveout only; do not enable Shoot/Burst, Ammo, repair, or other effects.

conflicts.title: Same-title direct, sheet, official, and licensed Equipment wording
conflicts.difference: Gatling, Plasma, Flamethrower, Tactical Hatchet, Sonic, Motion/Scanner, Engineering, Robot Controller, Grenade Launcher, and other variants differ in titles, traits, bodies, punctuation, slots, or local glyphs.
conflicts.resolution: Exact occurrence authority applies; never flatten by title/body/function or multiplicity.

conflicts.title: Generic and Character-labeled BackURLs versus face ownership/class
conflicts.difference: One generic SUPPORT ITEM back is shared by 24 Support and two Character-kit faces; five other backs are Character/source variants, including obsolete labels. A back label can conflict with current face owner.
conflicts.resolution: Backs remain non-operative source sides and never identify a current face, owner, class, or extra card.
